einzeiler: The GOP midterm convention in Dallas and Republican strategy to win voters
kurzfassung: Republicans are holding a midterm convention in Dallas this week to win back skeptical voters. The episode examines what will happen at the rally, whether it will work, and how plans differ from Democrats. Voting and political correspondents Miles Parks, Tamara Keith, and Mara Liasson discuss the event.
stichpunkte: Republican midterm convention in Dallas this week
Strategies to win back skeptical voters
Analysis by Miles Parks, Tamara Keith, and Mara Liasson
beschreibung:
Republicans are trying to win back skeptical voters by holding a midterm convention in Dallas this week. What will they do there, will the rally work, and how are their plans different than from what Democrats are planning?

This episode: voting correspondent Miles Parks, senior political correspondent Tamara Keith, and senior national political correspondent Mara Liasson.

This podcast was produced and edited by Casey Morell and Bria Suggs.
